name: afferent
description: A provider-neutral product feedback Convex component.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc --project tsconfig.json && cp src/component/tsconfig.json dist/component/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:model && npm run test:component && npm run test:auth-conformance && npm run test:scope && npm run test:backend && npm run test:package
scripts.test:demo:boundary: npm run codegen:demo && npm run typecheck:demo && vitest run tests/demo/host-boundary.test.ts tests/static/demo-boundary.test.ts
scripts.test:demo:lifecycle: npm run codegen:demo && npm run typecheck:demo && vitest run tests/demo/seeds.test.ts tests/demo/sandbox-lifecycle.test.ts tests/demo/host-boundary.test.ts tests/static/demo-boundary.test.ts
scripts.test:demo:maintenance: npm run codegen:demo && npm run typecheck:demo && vitest run tests/static/schema-scope.test.ts tests/component/sandbox-maintenance.test.ts tests/demo/sandbox-quotas.test.ts tests/demo/sandbox-cleanup.test.ts && npm run test:scope
scripts.test:fixtures: tsc --project fixtures/auth-convex-auth/tsconfig.json && tsc --project fixtures/auth-clerk/tsconfig.json && tsc --project fixtures/auth-better-auth/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:phase4: npm run verify:docs && npm run test:release:package && npm run test:demo:maintenance && npm run verify:demo:artifacts && npm run test:e2e:phase4
scripts.test:backend:phase2: npm run test:backend:real && node scripts/test-search-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-rate-limiter-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-tag-cleanup-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-fanout-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-outbox-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-merge-backend.mjs && node scripts/test-headless-backend.mjs
scripts.test:phase1: npm run build && npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:auth-conformance && npm run test:scope && npm run test:component && npm run test:static && npm run test:backend:real && npm run test:package
scripts.test:phase2: npm run build && npm run test:model && npm run test:component && npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:phase2 && npm run test:static && npm run test:react && npm run test:auth-conformance && npm run test:scope && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:package
scripts.test:phase3: npm run ui:check && npm run test:registry && npm exec -- vitest run --config vitest.react.config.ts tests/ui && npm exec -- vitest run --config vitest.react.config.ts tests/ui/hydration.test.tsx && npm exec -- vitest run tests/static/ui-contracts.test.ts tests/accessibility/contrast.test.ts && npm exec -- playwright test tests/accessibility/phase3.spec.ts && npm run test:phase2 && node --test tests/integration/phase3-gate.test.mjs
scripts.ui:check: npm run ui:generate && git diff --exit-code -- registry examples/ui/afferent
